channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tayshaun Prince | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tayshaun Prince from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Conley on Tayshaun Prince
item.description:
“Tayshaun Prince was probably the only vet we had that was older. Looking back at it, you could have told me we were going to be back the next year and the year after that. We were only going to get better from there.“But you never know what happens. We’re fired our coach. We got a new coach. Guys got traded. Guys got signed. Guys got hurt. Seizing the moment is real.”

Mike Conley on Tayshaun Prince, May 29, 2024. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Ben Wallace on Rasheed Wallace, Richard Hamilton, Chauncey Billups, Tayshaun Prince
item.description:
“Smart enough to draft Tayshaun Prince, smart enough to trade for Rip Hamilton, smart enough to trade for Chauncey Billups, smart enough to trade for and believe in Rasheed (Wallace). So you know, it is what it is.”

Ben Wallace on Rasheed Wallace, Richard Hamilton, Chauncey Billups, Tayshaun Prince, May 7, 2020. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Impact Basketball on Jared Dudley, Alan Anderson, Tayshaun Prince
item.description:
One Impact staffer explained why the underdog squad was so good:

“Alan Anderson was pissed off that he wasn’t in the NBA yet, so he would score lights out and always played with a chip on his shoulder. He wanted to show he belonged. Ty Lue ran the pick-and-roll to perfection. Jared Dudley always made the smart play and was shooting really well. Tayshaun Prince was probably their best all-around player. Overall, they were a really smart team; their basketball IQ was excellent. Even though it was a pick-up game, they played excellent help-side defense. They would double-team and frustrate the other team so much. For a while, they couldn’t lose.”

Impact Basketball on Jared Dudley, Alan Anderson, Tayshaun Prince, Aug 7, 2017. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Tayshaun Prince
item.description:
The Detroit Pistons announced today that the team has acquired forward Tayshaun Prince from the Boston Celtics in exchange for forwards Jonas Jerebko and Gigi Datome.

“Tayshaun Prince is certainly well known to fans in Detroit and we’re pleased to welcome him back,”

Stan Van Gundy on Tayshaun Prince, Feb 19, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Tayshaun Prince
item.description:
Marc D'Amico:Stevens on Prince playing time:

“I don't know how much we'll see him early on in this trip but he's been great since he walked in the door.”

Brad Stevens on Tayshaun Prince, Jan 19, 2015. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Tayshaun Prince
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Dumars:

“We want to thank Tayshaun for his professionalism and contributions over the last 10 years.”

Joe Dumars on Tayshaun Prince, Jan 30, 2013. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Joe Dumars on Tayshaun Prince, Rodney Stuckey
item.description:
Dumars said Wednesday night on 971 The Ticket.

“Stuckey is 24 or 25 (he's 25). He's a young guy and part of the rebuilding process. Tayshaun Prince, when you look at rebuilding, there is always going to be one veteran you have going forward with young guys.”

Joe Dumars on Tayshaun Prince, Rodney Stuckey, Jan 20, 2012. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Bill Duffy on Tayshaun Prince
item.description:
“Will Detroit probably want to re-sign him? Yes. One thing that the league is proposing is some type of phase-in. You won't see the immediate impact where it would be rigid. If the league were victorious, which we're obviously against, I think it will be a condensed free-agent period and guys like Tayshaun will still be high on people's list.”

Bill Duffy on Tayshaun Prince, Jul 12, 2011. Source: Detroit Free Press.
